sourceTitle: The Solitary of Juan Fernandez, or the Real Robinson Crusoe
description: "The Solitary of Juan Fernandez, or the Real Robinson Crusoe" by X.-B. Saintine is a novel written in the mid-19th century that reimagines the classic tale of survival and adventure inspired by Alexander Selkirk, who is often thought to be the real-life inspiration for Robinson Crusoe.
